evidence.evidence_text: To track and further incentivize the global development of equitable language technology, we introduce GlobalBench.
Prior multilingual benchmarks are static and have focused on a limited number of tasks and languages.
In contrast, GlobalBench is an ever-expanding collection that aims to dynamically track progress on all NLP datasets in all languages.
Despite the major advances in NLP, significant disparities in NLP system performance across languages still exist.
At present, the most under-served languages are the ones with a relatively high population, but nonetheless overlooked by composite multilingual benchmarks (like Punjabi, Portuguese, and Wu Chinese).
